lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing the steam on the glass
Watching the city shadows pass
A cup of tea turning cold
Stories of the day left untold
[Chorus]
Fading like a distant light
Folding into the velvet night
A melody caught in the air
Finding home in a quiet prayer
[Verse]
Dust motes dance in the hall
Shadows stretch against the wall
The clock ticks a steady beat
Where the past and present meet
[Chorus]
Fading like a distant light
Folding into the velvet night
A melody caught in the air
Finding home in a quiet prayer
[Bridge]
The truth hides in the gray
Wait for the words to stay
[Chorus]
Fading like a distant light
Folding into the velvet night
A melody caught in the air
Finding home in a quiet prayer
[Outro]
